card.name: Small linking words in popular science prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, our, about, 's, a, away, of, not) right after a verb or noun in general-audience news or science writing, often about astronomy or science. The next word is an object or abstract noun phrase.

modes.label: Preposition after verb
modes.description: A preposition or particle follows a verb such as pondered, watched, give or know.
modes.example: the journalists of America pondered<< with>> grave concern the fact that for fifteen days

modes.label: Determiner or possessive
modes.description: An article or possessive follows a verb or preposition and leads into a noun phrase.
modes.example: infect them with<< a>> sense of wonder.

modes.label: Possessive or of after noun
modes.description: A 's or of links a noun to the topic that follows.
modes.example: here are ten things you probably didn't know about our solar system<<'s>> more minor bodies.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are a mixed set such as secret and familiar.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in magazine-style science writing, just before the thing being described.
evidence: the journalists of America pondered<< with>> grave concern the fact that for fifteen days
infect them with<< a>> sense of wonder.
an unlikely mediator in the spread<< of>> Lyme disease.
